description: Searches surfaced May Day reporting about Béjaïa and Radio Algérienne worker-day coverage. The separate >32 figure is legislators’ signatures, not participants. Le Jour search-only May Day results are dated 2021-05-01 and 2024-05-02. Radio page has no confirmed HTTP response/body; DNS failure reported but not independently inspectable. No May 2025 event established. Access-history qualification: an earlier distinct El Bilad body capture exists with request/provider time unknown; it was saved before the recorded manual-review completion, so review-before-request cannot be shown. That earlier capture is preserved but excluded from factual evidence. Only the separate 00:06:17–18 post-review open supports the bounded article summary. No retroactive authorization is claimed.
required_followup: For the earlier El Bilad capture, retain chronology as unresolved and do not use it as evidence; do not repeat requests. The later post-review capture supports only the planned action description and not year, execution, attendance or threshold. A date-appropriate independent account is still needed to establish any May 2025 event.
